g.text: TASK-260715-1pn983 — orthogonal reconnect and rekey reservations
Per-lane permanent KEX reservation state machine
KEX reservation exists in idle and active states.
Existing flows stay pinned; triggers coalesce into a bounded bitset.
Constructor is unreachable until reservation succeeds atomically.
Critical construction is unreachable until old cleanup is observed.
success / old keys and scratch released
stop invalidates lane and joins cleanup
